I need to identify the odd numbers in the group and add them up to see if they sum to an even number.

The numbers in the group are: 15, 32, 5, 13, 82, 7, 1

The odd numbers are: 15, 5, 13, 7, 1

Adding all the odd numbers: 15 + 5 + 13 + 7 + 1 = 41

Since 41 is an odd number, the odd numbers do not add up to an even number.

The answer is False.
